symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: An element of $\mathcal T$, that is, a three-element subset of $[h]$ that indexes a bit of each bank.
symbols.quote: let $\Delta$ and $\Delta'$ denote elements of $\mathcal T$, which we call triples.

symbols.name: source bank
symbols.meaning: The family of bits that a forward invocation reads, with one bit $\Xi_\Delta$ for each triple $\Delta$.
symbols.quote: The source bank $\Xi$ holds one bit $\Xi_\Delta$ for each triple $\Delta$

symbols.name: target bank
symbols.meaning: The family of bits that a forward invocation updates, with one bit $Y_\Delta$ for each triple $\Delta$.
symbols.quote: the target bank $Y$ holds one bit $Y_\Delta$ for each triple $\Delta$.

symbols.name: ground element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set $[h]$, which indexes one central wire.
symbols.quote: For each element $\upsilon$ of $[h]$ there is a central wire $J_\upsilon$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire attached to the ground element $\upsilon$.
symbols.quote: For each element $\upsilon$ of $[h]$ there is a central wire $J_\upsilon$.

symbols.name: side wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire attached to the ordered neighbouring pair of triples $(\Delta,\Delta')$.
symbols.quote: For each ordered neighbouring pair $(\Delta,\Delta')$ there is a side wire $\zeta_{\Delta\Delta'}$.

relations.quote: The bit network is a binary instance of [linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md), since its wires carry scalars of $\mathbb{F}_2$, the field with two elements in which addition is exclusive or and multiplication is AND.
The bit network realises a [binary change of basis](binary-change-of-basis.md) on tape by interchanging equal address chunks.
